data.notes: WebSearch budget (20) used; one call failed with rate limit. No VW press kit numbers were directly retrievable; ADAC Autokatalog (manufacturer data) used as main source. Model years: B7 Limousine from 11/2010, B8 Limousine from late 2014 until 2019 facelift.

corrections.evidence: Official VW predecessor-model page for Passat B8: Limousine height 1456 mm (closed trunk, without antenna/roof rails); Variant 1477 mm. Also carwow.co.uk and fastcarcheck.uk give 1456 mm for the saloon. ADAC/ams 1476 mm is a non-manufacturer-preferred value.
Official VW Passat B8 page states wheelbase 2791 mm; carwow.co.uk 2015 Passat dimensions guide and fastcarcheck.uk also give 2,791 mm. ADAC/mobile.de list 2786 mm.

missing.detail: T6.1 Multivan lang (German market 10/2019-10/2021): ADAC (manufacturer data) gives 5304 mm length, 1990 mm height, 3400 mm wheelbase, same as T6 lang; e.g. https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw-nutzfahrzeuge/transporter/t61-facelift/306354 . Start 10/2019 falls within the 2005-2019 scope.

T5 Multivan lang (facelift, 09/2009-05/2015): ADAC lists length 5292 mm, wheelbase 3400 mm (2.0 TDI/TSI Comfortline), e.g. https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw-nutzfahrzeuge/transporter/t5-facelift/220469/ ; height not verified.

B7 1.4 TSI EcoFuel (CNG, 150 PS) Limousine: ADAC lists 541 l for R-Line (10/12-09/14, https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw/passat/b7/234065) but 565 l for Business Edition (11/13-07/14); conflicting, not added as correction.

verification.notes: 16 WebSearch calls used. Confirmed: T6 Multivan lang 5304/1904/1990/3400 and years; Alltrack B7 4771/1820/1550, 588/1716 l (wheelbase 2712 vs ams 2710 unresolved, no manufacturer figure found); Alltrack B8 4777/1832/1506/2789, 639/1769 l; B6 4765/1820/1472, 565 l (wheelbase 2709 vs angurten 2710, minor); B7 4769/1820/1470 (VW newsroom-derived range 1462-1470)/2712, 565 l; B8 length 4767, width 1832, folded 1152 l (VW 'bis zu 1152 l'), 586 l (fastcarcheck), GTE 402 l (auto-motor-und-sport). GTE folded 968 l not confirmed nor refuted. Note: the 2015 GTE ams data sheet itself lists 1476/2786, so the corrected VW values may apply to non-GTE sedans; VW official page is used as manufacturer figure.
